scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!
O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleeeigh, Hey!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
叮叮当！叮叮当！铃儿响叮当！
坐着单马拉的敞篷雪橇，真是快乐呀——嘿！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Merry Christmas!
Hey! You! What comes to mind when you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
圣诞快乐！
嘿！你！一想到圣诞节，你会想到什么？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Jingle Bells! Jingle Bells! Jingle all the way!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
叮叮当！叮叮当！铃儿响叮当！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
O' what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
坐着单马拉的敞篷雪橇，真是快乐呀！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Merry Christmas!
Hey, boy! What comes to mind when
you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
圣诞快乐！
嘿，小伙子！说到圣诞节，你最先想到什么？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Merry Christmas!
Hey, girl! What comes to mind when
you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
圣诞快乐！
嘿，姑娘！说到圣诞节，你最先想到什么？

scripts.text: Santa Claus
scripts.translation: 圣诞老人

scripts.text: Gift Boxes
scripts.translation: 礼物盒

scripts.text: Carols
scripts.translation: 颂歌

scripts.text: Santa Costumes
scripts.translation: 圣诞老人服装

scripts.text: Fake Santa Antonio
scripts.translation: 假圣诞老人安东尼奥

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Santa Claus!
You're so innocent!!
Ah!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
圣诞老人！
你还真有童心啊！！
啊！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Here's a secret!
There's a rumor that Santa Claus lives in a certain village all throughout the year.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
告诉你一个秘密！
有传言说，圣诞老人一年到头都住在某个村庄里。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
But now!!!
In this Christmas season!!
You guys can meet Santa on either of the five possible villages throughout Rune-Midgerts!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
不过现在！！！圣诞节期间！！
卢恩·米德加兹有五个村庄可能出现圣诞老人，去那里就有机会见到他！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you win over Santa, you can get a gift. Would you go for it?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
赢过圣诞老人，就能得到礼物。
要去试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Isn't that big news?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
颂歌者的独家新闻！哈！
这消息够大的吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Gift boxes?! All right!
Isn't it thrilling to open gifts over your head!!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
礼物盒？！不错！
举过头顶打开礼物，多让人兴奋啊！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Anyway, did you know...
Some villain, a fake Santa robbed some gifts from the good Santa!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
对了，你听说了吗...
有个假圣诞老人抢走了真正的圣诞老人准备的礼物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Furthermore, he has put bad magic on the gifts so that they become monsters!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
而且，他在礼物上施了邪恶的魔法，让它们变成了魔物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Isn't it amazing?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
颂歌者的独家新闻！哈！
是不是很惊人？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Ah, a music box is useful.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
啊，音乐盒很有用。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Though we can't all play it around the village as we planned, it's cool that you carry it.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
虽然不能按原计划在村里到处播放，但能随身带着音乐盒，也挺不错的。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We want to enjoy carols all together... I hope to get Crystal Pieces!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
我们想和大家一起欣赏颂歌...真希望能找到水晶碎片！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text: Why not? Sure, I can give you some.
scripts.translation: 当然，给你一些

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Yes, please.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
好的，拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Wow, you have them.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
哇，你居然有。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
I can bake you a cake, and I can carve your name on the cake, if you want!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
我可以给你烤个蛋糕，你愿意的话，还能在上面写上你的名字！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: Please name it for me.
scripts.translation: 请写上我的名字

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Thank for your help!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
谢谢你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
世界这么大，住着那么多人！
许多人都想听我唱颂歌，可我总是缺少水晶碎片。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
在这个圣诞季，让我们多关心身边的人吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Oh!
Shyness!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
啊！
害羞了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Anyway, thanks a lot for your help.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
总之，非常感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Many people live in the giant world!
So many people hope to hear Caroller, yet I always lack Crystal pieces.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
世界这么大，住着那么多人！
许多人都想听我唱颂歌，可我总是缺少水晶碎片。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
If you can get ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000, give them to me please?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
找到^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000的话，能把它们给我吗？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Let's care about others around you on this Christmas season!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
在这个圣诞季，让我们多关心身边的人吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You know about Christmas!
Talking about Christmas...
...it's carols!!!
I've been waiting for this for when
Christmas comes around!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
你懂圣诞节！
说到圣诞节...当然是颂歌！！！
我一直盼着圣诞节到来，好好唱个痛快！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
But there's been no caroling here and there like before, so we can't feel the Christmas spirit.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
可现在不像以前，到处都能听到颂歌了，连圣诞气氛都淡了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
So, I installed a Singing Crystal in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
所以，我在普隆德拉安装了一个歌唱水晶...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
but that jerk Antonio broke the crystal!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
但那个混蛋安东尼奥把水晶弄坏了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
The gift boxes have been changing into monsters since Antonio placed some magic on them, so the monsters ate up the crystal fragments!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
安东尼奥给礼物盒施了魔法，把它们变成魔物，那些魔物又把水晶碎片吃掉了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
I am so devastated, since the Singing Crystal has been the hope of many children around the villages.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
周围村庄的许多孩子都盼着听歌唱水晶呢，这让我难过极了。

scripts.text: There's no other way to carol?
scripts.translation: 没有其他办法唱颂歌了吗？

scripts.text: You can hear carols in Lutie.
scripts.translation: 姜饼城能听到颂歌

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
And just stay there, every Christmas, for your whole life?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
那就每年圣诞节都待在那里，一辈子都这样吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Oh, nevermind.
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
哦，算了。
啊...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
给村庄做点唱机也许不容易，不过音乐盒应该能做出来。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
我们需要魔物吃掉的^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
带来^0000FF6个歌唱水晶碎片^000000，我就送你礼物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Sounds cool, huh!!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
听起来很酷，对吧！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
...Why are you staring at me like that?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
...你为什么那样盯着我看？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You're thinking that we are always getting our plans spoiled, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
你是不是在想，我们的计划怎么总被人搞砸？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
I know that we are not good at controlling stuff, but our rewards are good, right?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
我知道我们不太会处理这些事，不过给的奖励还不错，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Hey, we treat you good...
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
嘿，我们对你很好的...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You are so cruel to me!
Bad! Bad!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
你也太无情了！
坏人！坏人！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please, for our children's hope!!!?
Please bring me 6 Singing Crystal Pieces from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
拜托了，为了孩子们的希望！！！
请从^0000FF暴力礼物盒^000000身上收集6个歌唱水晶碎片带来！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Go on please!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
它们还真是名副其实的凶暴。
拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Santa costumes!!
You know, the santa costumes that the monsters are wearing now aren't genuine!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
圣诞老人服装！！
你知道吗，魔物现在穿的圣诞老人服装不是正品！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
The rumor 'round here is, Lutie's designer made these costumes.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
听说这些服装是姜饼城的设计师做的。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Every year, adventurers challenge to attack Antonio the fake Santa, but there's no way to catch up to him due to his hat and costume!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
每年都有冒险者挑战假圣诞老人安东尼奥，可他有那顶帽子和那身衣服，谁也追不上！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Are there some special abilities within them?
There's still the designer in the Christmas village... How about asking her to make that costume?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
难道帽子和衣服有什么特殊能力？
那位设计师还在圣诞村呢...不如请她也做一套？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
It's hot, huh?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
颂歌者的独家新闻！哈！
很劲爆，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
A-N-T-O-N-I-O!!!
As I heard, this Antonio is quite different from before.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
安-东-尼-奥！！！
我听说，这个安东尼奥和以前很不一样了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
He seems to be quite resolved with himself since he ran away from people before.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
以前他总是逃跑，现在似乎下了决心，不再像以前那样了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
And he isn't alone anymore... is what I heard...
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
而且，他现在不是独自行动了...听说是这样...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Caroller's hot news! Ha!
Hotness, right?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
颂歌者的独家新闻！哈！
很劲爆，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Maybe, it's quite hard to make a jukebox for the villages, but a music box might be possible.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
给村庄做点唱机也许不容易，不过音乐盒应该能做出来。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We need the ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 that the monsters ate up.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
我们需要魔物吃掉的^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please bring me ^0000FF6 Singing Crystal Pieces^000000, and you will be rewarded with presents!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
带来^0000FF6个歌唱水晶碎片^000000，我就送你礼物！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
For all of the children of this world!!!
Please bring me ^0000FFSinging Crystal Pieces^000000 from ^0000FFViolent Gift Boxes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
为了这世上所有的孩子！！！
请帮我收集^0000FF歌唱水晶碎片^000000，去找那些^0000FF暴力礼物盒^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Be careful!
They're definitely as harsh as their name.
Take care!!!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
小心！它们还真是名副其实的凶暴。
多保重！！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Don't cry, don't cry!
Santa won't give you a gift if you're crying.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
别哭，别哭！
如果你哭了，圣诞老人就不会给你礼物了。

scripts.text: [Caroller]
scripts.translation: [颂歌者]

scripts.text: I got them!
scripts.translation: 我拿到了！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Wow, you got them!
They are so cruel, aren't they?
I'm happy to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
哇，拿到了！
它们很凶吧？
真高兴你平安回来了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Let's count together!
... ...
Six!!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
让我们一起数一数！
... ...
六个！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
All right! We can start to make our music box with crystal fragments.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
好！这下能用水晶碎片做音乐盒了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We would amplify the sounds of the crystal fragments to sound through the music box.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
把水晶碎片的声音放大，再通过音乐盒播放出来。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You know, a music box that sounds like a jukebox!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
也就是说，做个能像点唱机一样播放音乐的音乐盒！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
It's handy. You can carry it, as well as listen to sweet carols anywhere.
Doesn't that sound cool!?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
它很方便。你可以随身携带，随时随地聆听甜美的颂歌。
听起来很酷，不是吗！？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
还需要一些材料。
^0000FF10个树干、1个高级铁砧、1个朱毕雷、10个粘稠液体和3克拉钻石^000000！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Those are all needed.
Isn't that easy?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
这些就是全部所需。
不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
We can make a music box with Singing Crystal Pieces.
It's handy, you can hear carols anywhere. Sounds cool?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
用歌唱水晶碎片就能做音乐盒。
随身带着，走到哪里都能听颂歌，是不是很棒？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
So, we need more of some materials.
^0000FF10 Trunk, 1 Hammer Of Blacksmith, 1 Jubilee, 10 Sticky Mucus, 3carat Diamond^000000!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
还需要一些材料。
^0000FF10个树干、1个高级铁砧、1个朱毕雷、10个粘稠液体和3克拉钻石^000000！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
That's all we need.
Isn't that easy?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
这些就是全部所需。
不难吧？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Jingle bells, jingle bells,
jingle all the way!
O what fun it is to ride, in a
one... horse... o-pen... sleigh!!!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
叮叮当，叮叮当，铃儿响叮当！
坐着...一匹马拉的...敞篷...雪橇，真是快乐呀！！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Wow!
You came back!
Did you bring all the materials?
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
哇！
你回来了！
材料都带齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Good!
No need to hesitate! Let's get started to make our music box.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
好！别犹豫了，开始做音乐盒吧。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Blacksmith hammers on trunk... and we shape the frame.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
用铁匠的锤子敲打树干...把框架做出来。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Please use the Singing Crystal Pieces for a column, the Diamond as a prop, and the Sticky Mucus as glue.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
请使用歌唱水晶碎片作为支柱，钻石作为支撑，粘稠液体作为胶水。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
And now...
we decorate with a Jubilee...
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
然后...用朱毕雷装饰一下...

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
The last step...!
Breating life into it!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
最后一步...！
赋予它生命！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
It's done now!!!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
完成了！！！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
It's so cool! Isn't it cute!!?!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
太酷了！是不是很可爱！！？！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
You did as I requested, so I will give you gifts, as promised.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
你帮我办好了这件事，接下来该兑现承诺，送你礼物了。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
One, is this music box.
Please play this music box all over the villages!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
第一份礼物，就是这个音乐盒。
带着它到各个村庄播放吧！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Another present is a Christmas cake especially shaped like your name!
I made this cake shaped like your name!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
另一份礼物，是特意做成你名字形状的圣诞蛋糕！
你看，形状就是你的名字哦！

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Don't worry, it tastes good.
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
别担心，味道很好的。

scripts.text:
[Caroller]
Thanks a lot.
Merry Christmas!
Have a good holiday season!
scripts.translation:
[颂歌者]
非常感谢。
圣诞快乐！
假期愉快！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Wow! Were you naughty or nice this year?
All right, what comes to your mind when you think about Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
哇！今年你是乖孩子，还是调皮的孩子呢？
说到圣诞节，你最先想到什么？

scripts.text: Carolling
scripts.translation: 唱颂歌

scripts.text: Santa Claus
scripts.translation: 圣诞老人

scripts.text: Gift Boxes
scripts.translation: 礼物盒

scripts.text: Santa Costume
scripts.translation: 圣诞老人服装

scripts.text: Not much really...
scripts.translation: 没什么特别的...

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Carolling! That's good!
A sweet carol always makes Christmas more happy!!!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
唱颂歌！不错！
动听的颂歌总能让圣诞节更快乐！！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Yes indeed Carolling spreads Joy throughout the world?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
是啊，颂歌能把欢乐传遍世界，对不对？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Ho ho ho! What a good boy!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
Ho ho ho! 真是个乖男孩！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Ho ho ho! What a good girl!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
Ho ho ho! 真是个乖女孩！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
But you should be wary of a fake Santa romaing around.
Have you heard of Antonio, who invades villages every Christmas?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
不过，要小心那个到处乱跑的假圣诞老人。
听说过安东尼奥吗？他每年圣诞节都会闯进村庄捣乱。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
He has stolen my gifts, as well as attacked adventurers around Toy and Lutie field.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
他偷走了我的礼物，还袭击了玩具城和姜饼城野外附近的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
A bad Santa ruins us good Santa's reputations!
The World Santa Organization is considering this a grave situation.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
坏圣诞老人把我们这些好圣诞老人的名声都毁了！
世界圣诞老人组织对这件事非常重视。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
A gift box! That sounds good!
It's so exciting to open gift boxes when you wake up on Christmas morning!!!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
礼物盒！不错！
圣诞节早晨一醒来就能打开礼物盒，多让人兴奋啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
But we have very little gifts now, since Santa Antonio has stolen my gift bag.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
可现在剩下的礼物不多了，安东尼奥偷走了我的礼物袋。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Many adventurers try to catch up to him, but he is not easy to catch.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
许多冒险者试图追上他，但他并不容易抓住。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Anyway let those adventurers try to catch him, I have a small game for you.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
总之就让那些冒险者去抓他吧，我有个小游戏要和你玩。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I will give you a small gift if you beat me!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
如果你赢了我，我会给你一份小礼物！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Do you want to play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
你想和我玩个小游戏吗？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: Yes, I would.
scripts.translation: 好，我来玩

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Aww, don't be afraid.
If you've been a little naughty this year I won't stuff your stockings with coal.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
哎呀，别害怕。
如果你今年有点淘气，我也不会往你的袜子里塞煤块。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I will stay here throughout the Christmas season, just visit me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
圣诞节期间我都会在这里，改变主意了就来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Um... You've played the game recently haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
嗯...你最近玩过这个游戏吧？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You can try the game once a hour.
Please visit me after the one hour has passed.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
每小时只能玩一次。
等满一小时再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Wow! You're so cool!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
哇！你真厉害！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Let me explain how to play this game.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
我来讲讲玩法。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
It's quite simple.
I will pick one of three cards: Poring Card, Ghostring Card, and Angeling Card.
Guess which card I pick and you're a winner!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
很简单。
我会从三张卡片中选一张：波利卡片、幽灵波利卡片和天使波利卡片。
猜中我选的是哪张卡片，你就赢了！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
If you guess right 3 times out of 5, I will give you a gift.
Let's get started!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
如果你能在5次中猜对3次，我就给你一份礼物。
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
First let me shuffle up these cards... Ok!!!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
让我先洗牌... 好了！！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
One!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
一！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Two!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
二！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Three!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
三！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I'm picking up only one!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
我只抽一张！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I'm picking up only one!
Please guess what is is.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
我只抽一张！
猜猜是哪张。

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Angeling
scripts.translation: 天使波利

scripts.text: Ghostring
scripts.translation: 幽灵波利

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...I choose Poring!

[{0}]
Um...I choose Angeling!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我选天使波利！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...I choose Ghostring!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我选幽灵波利！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Let's see!!
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
揭晓答案！！
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Let's see!!
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
揭晓答案！！
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You're lucky.
Can you guess the right card the next time around?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
你真幸运。
下一轮还能猜对吗？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Aww maybe next time...
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
哎呀，下次再试吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is just luck.
Let me try again!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这全凭运气嘛。
让我再试一次！！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
随时都可以。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You're so good!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
你真棒！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Now this gift is for you.
Put your hand into the bag and pick only one.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
这是给你的礼物。
把手伸进袋子里，只拿一样。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Good job! Thanks for playing the card game with me!
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
做得好！谢谢你陪我玩纸牌游戏！
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Do you mean that ever so fashionable costume for Santa's and youngsters!?!
Light-weight, fashionable, and keeps you warm!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
你是说圣诞老人和年轻人都爱穿的时尚服装吗？！
轻便、时髦，还保暖！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
There used to be designer who visited my house to make my Santa costumes.
Do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
以前有位设计师来我家，帮我做圣诞服装。
你有什么想法吗？

[圣诞老人]
...

[圣诞老人]
...
哦！可怜的男孩...

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
........................
Oh! Poor girl...
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
...
哦！可怜的女孩...

[圣诞老人]
...
哦！可怜的男孩...
...

[圣诞老人]
...
哦！可怜的女孩...
...

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
You should open your heart to the spirit of Christmas!
Once you do, I know you'll be able to think of something.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
敞开心扉，感受圣诞节的精神吧！
只要这样，一定就能想到些什么。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I always thought about how boring Santa Claus is wearing a too boring costume.
Too boring!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
我一直觉得，圣诞老人穿着那身毫无新意的衣服，实在太单调了。
太单调！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I could make a glamorous style for him!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
我能给他设计一个华丽的造型！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I once made a costume for the notorious figure Antonio!
The reason catching up to him is so hard, is that his clothes have been given strong power!
I blessed them with good luck!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
我曾给臭名昭著的安东尼奥做过一套服装！
他那么难追，就是因为我给衣服注入了强大的力量，还加上了好运的祝福！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Preta Porter!!
Which is quite luxurious but sold at good price ~
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
高级成衣！！
奢华又实惠~

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Hey loosers!
You can share my sense of fashion and wear my look if you run a light mission for me.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
嘿，土包子们！
帮我完成一个小任务，就能体验我的时尚品味，穿上我设计的服装。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
你们感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，请说

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Ah!
You're silly! You lost your big chance!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
啊！
真傻！你错过了大好机会！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Come to me later if you want to get the mission.
I, Louise Kim, am generous enough to accept you next time.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
想接任务了就回来找我吧。
我路易丝·金这么大方，下次也会给你机会。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
You're so cool.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
你真酷。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Don't worry about this mission.
It's not that difficult.
I'm only in need of some materials. Things that are beyond my ability...
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
别担心，任务不难。
我只是需要些材料，有些东西我自己实在弄不到...

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Anyway, can you bring me some stuff?
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
总之，你能帮我带点东西来吗？

scripts.text: Why not? What do you need?
scripts.translation: 没问题，需要什么

scripts.text: Sorry, no time.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，没时间

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
What?
You will definitely regret it.
No more chances later.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
什么？
你肯定会后悔的。
以后可没机会了。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
All right, you're cool!!
You need to bring me: ^0000FFCotton Shirt, 3 Red Potion, Holy Water, 4 Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Lace^000000.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
好吧，你真酷！！
你需要给我带：^0000FF棉衬衫、3个红色药水、圣水、4个包装纸、缎带^000000。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
If you bring me all that stuff, I can make you a glamorous Santa costume.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
如果你把这些东西都带给我，我就能为你做一套华丽的圣诞老人服装。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
If you were to bring me all the stuff, I would make you a wonderful costume, for free...
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
如果你把这些东西都带给我，我会免费为你做一套很棒的服装...

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Please see me again if you are interested.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
如果你有兴趣，请再来找我。

scripts.text: Here you are.
scripts.translation: 给你

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Oh! Good!
Let's not delay.
I will show you my limitless ability.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
哦！好！别耽搁了。
让你见识一下我无穷的本领。

scripts.text:
-She pours everything in a pot-
-even the shirt goes in!-
-She takes it out with skill-
-and many blessings she sings.-
scripts.translation:
-她把所有东西倒进锅里，连衬衫也放进去了！-
-接着熟练地取出衬衫，嘴里唱着祝福的歌。-

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
By artist, Louise Kim!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
有艺术家路易丝·金在！
今晚全世界都将得到祝福！

scripts.text:
-Pour red potion in another pot-
-then stir all of its parts.-
-Put the cotton shirts in-
-and dye it for grateful hearts.-
-Thread by thread-
-String by string-
-Count your blessings and sing!-
scripts.translation:
-把红色药水倒进另一口锅，搅拌均匀。-
-放入棉衬衫，为感恩的心染上色彩。-
-一针一线，一丝一缕。-
-细数所得的祝福，唱起歌来！-

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
By artist, Louise Kim!
All over the world will be blessed tonight!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
有艺术家路易丝·金在！
今晚全世界都将得到祝福！

scripts.text:
-She is knitting clothes-
-with a hooked needle-
-with her great skill.-
-Spread your blessings,-
-cheer and goodwill!-
scripts.translation:
-她凭着高超的技巧，用钩针编织衣服。-
-传递祝福、欢乐和善意！-

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
This is miraculous!
I am a genius of the world.
Artist, Louise Kim!!!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
这太神奇了！
我是世界级的天才。
艺术家，路易丝·金！！！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
All right! Isn't it wonderful?
You can call it what you wish.
My fashion is radiant.
I ain't envious of Designer Pierre.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
好了！是不是很棒？
随你怎么称呼，它都一样耀眼夺目。
我才不羡慕设计师皮埃尔呢。

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
I am supposed to get paid well, however I will just let it be free, since this is Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
我本来应该收很多钱的，但既然是圣诞节，我就免费给你吧！

scripts.text:
[Louise Kim]
Go brag about these wonderful clothes. There wouldn't be any without me, Louise Kim.
scripts.translation:
[路易丝·金]
去炫耀这套漂亮衣服吧。
没有我路易丝·金，可就没有它！
